title: Time well spent with a great guide
text: 15 years of living in Barcelona has left Adi with a great knowledge of the city and a love for Barcelona that shines through.   It was a pleasure to spend  time  in his company.   A great sense of humour too.   Book him, you won't regret your  choice.
author: BDwalkingtours

title: Amazing Barcelona tour with Alessandro
text: Amazing tour made possible by Alessandro’s great knowledge. As a guide, he really connects with his guests and shares a unique perspective. This is quite possibly the best tour I’ve ever done.
author: Zain_Khan_10

title: Excellent
text: Adi was fabulous- so professional, knowledgeable and entertaining. He showed us and explained points of interest that we otherwise would never have even noticed. Highly recommend.
author: Elizabeth_D

title: Awesome tour with Sebastian
text: Awesome tour with Sebastian - Grounded history, engaging, started at Gran Teatre del Liceu, went into the Gothic quarter, into the Jewish quarter,  sharing the historic significance of each section. He was a great sport as it was pouring and shared a super comprehensive restaurant list and his favorite rock and metal bar. Would definitely take another tour with him next time we're in Barcelona!
author: my-anqle

title: Beautiful Barcelona. We loved it!
text: Tomas was attentive to my husbands reduced mobility but still able to show us a beautiful part of Barcelona. He was a wonderful guide who knows his history well but also knows the best Torrone shop in Spain.
author: aussieontour42

title: In depth Barcelona
text: Alessandro's knowledge of Barcelona's history (and of that of the Mediterranean) spans mediaeval through to present day. He expanded in more detail when asked about particular issues. We walked around the city and he described the past and current function of a variety of places and buildings. Where past infrastructure has been lost, he would describe where it had been, eg the Roman wall. Look 1.5hrs is just not enough. If you are considering a booking, try for a longer tour. A great guide, can't recommend him enough.
author: brontee472

title: Awesome
text: Guide was very helpful, knowledgeable, and provided a lot of insight of Spain’s history. You’ll enjoy.
author: Nadine_C

title: Brilliant introduction to beautiful Barcelona!
text:
Jordi was very flexible and knowledgeable in answering all our questions be it on historical, cultural or practical points. 
His English is impeccable. 
We warmly recommend his tour.
author: cilex001

title: Jordi the amazing tour guide
text: Jordi grew up in Barcelona. Is trained /schooled as an architect which added to his excellent knowledge of the city history and architecture - he was very friendly , timely , patient , and overall a very nice person.  Our group of 6 were all very happy with the tour and even asked him to join us for lunch but he had more tours to give .
author: glenn391

title: Wonderful
text: A big thank you to Jordi for the tour of Barcelona.  An excellent and appreciated day out with your knowledge of your town .
author: Olivier C
